body.asks: The author's ask of 2026-11-11, a little of it built that day: a board, its widgets each a slot drawn by the component it names across the columns it spans, laid out to fit the room; a count, bars counted by a key, a timeline placed by two moments, a list beside them; a board within a board; each widget entered by a press; The work, live watching the work through the one engine. Left: components saying the sizes they may take, rather than the board saying spans; a histogram over values a way of looking cannot give as holons; bars reading each holon, where one read of values would do; a timeline drawn again only when the field changes, not as time goes; the address bar showing a lambda raw where a widget is entered; and whether the board grows into the open-ended reader, a widget hosting sub-widgets where a slice holds slices.
